eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; Pima, AZ; at 2:03 PM on SEP 14, 2026 Effective until 10:03 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A safe Alert has been issued for Pima County. The Tucson Police Department is looking for 25-year-old Kathian Albina De La Cruz Cifuentes. Kathian is a Hispanic female 5 feet tall, 125 pounds, with brown eyes and black hair. Kathian was last seen wearing a light pink t-shirt, and dark colored knee length pants. Kathian was last seen on 09/13/2026 at 2:00 P.M. on foot near South Kolb Road near East 22nd Street, Tucson. Kathian suffers from a medical condition which may cause her to become lost or easily confused. Please call 911 with information.. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
